t: Except for the appropriations entitled “Contingency Fund”, “Alliance for Progress, development loans”, and “Development loans”, not more than 20 per centum of any appropriation item made available by this title shall be obligated and/or reserved during the last month of availability.

fable.w: This section only limits how much of an appropriation may be obligated or reserved in the last month of availability. The mention of the "Alliance for Progress" is just the name of an appropriation account, not a process of consulting any outside party. No state, tribe, expert, company, or member of the public is involved in any federal decision, and there is no rulemaking, hearing, advisory body, or right to sue.
fable.s: not more than 20 per centum of any appropriation item made available by this title shall be obligated and/or reserved during the last month of availability
